name: Vanishing Point Aided Hash-Frequency Encoding
definition: A neural radiance field encoding scheme that combines multi-resolution hash encoding with deterministic frequency encoding aligned to scene structure via vanishing points, designed to improve reconstruction from sparse 360° inputs without additional depth or pre-training.
summary: Vanishing Point Aided Hash-Frequency Encoding combines multi-resolution hash encoding with vanishing-point-aligned frequency features to improve reconstruction quality from sparse inputs without requiring depth data.
